item.title: 'No one should be left out in the cold': Service agencies work to fill need
item.description: A cold notification issued on Friday, January 22 marks the seventh such health advisory issued so far this winter. item.title: Public invited to provide views on new Lions Park playground designs
item.description: The City of Brantford is inviting residents to help shape the new playground design at Lions Park Steve Brown Sports Complex. item.description: DNA provides the foundational library of possibilities, but the environment serves as the librarian, choosing which books are pulled from the shelves and opened

item.title: Missing person safely located: police
item.description: A person — identified as 37-year-old Sarah — who previously reported missing has been safely located, say Brantford Police. The Brantford Police Service thank the public for their concern and information.

item.title: Would-be robber got more than he 'bargained for', Brantford judge says
item.description: A disguised man who went into the Downtown Pawnbroker shop in October 2024 intending to rob the place was surprised when the owner and customers turned on him.
